definitions.explanation: All eight compass directions (the four cardinal and four intermediate directions), or more generally, all directions.

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: To be attacked from all directions.

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}⟦{塞|ふさ}がり→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}って→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm stuck with no way out (blocked in all directions).

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われたくない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to be called a people-pleaser (someone who tries to please everyone).

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くした→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{解決|かいけつ}{策|さく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I tried every possible means, but couldn't find a solution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四方|しほう}{八方|はっぽう}→四方八方：16104_shihouhappou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦きて→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ばされそう→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Wind blew from every direction and the tent nearly blew away.

notes:
The eight directions are the four compass points and the four between them; in practice {八方|はっぽう} means "every side" and appears mostly in fixed expressions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がり→八方塞がり：07741_happoufusagari⟧: blocked on every side; no way out
- ⟦{八方美人|はっぽうびじん}→八方美人：08052_happoubijin⟧: someone who tries to please everyone (usually critical)
- {八方|はっぽう}⟦{手|て}を{尽|つ}くす→手を尽くす：31589_tewotsukusu⟧: to try every possible means
- ⟦{四方八方|しほうはっぽう}→四方八方：16104_shihouhappou⟧: in all directions, every which way

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{四方|しほう}→四方：08729_shihou⟧: the four directions; all around
- ⟦{全方位|ぜんほうい}→全方位：23944_zenhoui⟧: all directions, omnidirectional
